items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta or full launch; conditional for ordinary reversible fleet growth; counsel_required for upstream data rights, jurisdiction-specific privacy treatment, vendor/DPA obligations, and future affiliate or advertising use. Keep SearchWoot private. Evidence: API access is documented, but public/commercial reuse rights are not; current terms point against the proposed use. Compliance is technical only: 37 pass, 16 fail, 6 unknown. Analytics freshness and revenue attribution are yellow; revenue is $4.92 aggregate for 2026-09-21 with $0 site-attributed commission. Security, accuracy/freshness, measurement/attribution, and owner gates remain incomplete. No go-live proposal is supported.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 legal tasks closed. Partial evidence exists in official API documentation and terms, repository/configuration data-flow files, privacy and cookie pages, and draft terms. No task is closable. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only bundle containing the field-level rights matrix, alert and operational data flows, identifiers, retention, deletion, correction, access, notification consent and unsubscribe behavior, GA4 configuration and retention, log fields, vendor/DPA coverage, and incident/request procedures. Do not send outreach or change the private gate.

Data-use dispositions: Woot API deal and price-history data = blocked and counsel_required for public display, derivatives, alerts, affiliate use, or advertising. Missing written permission/API agreement, field-level provenance and rights, caching/display/alert terms, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark/image/price-use limits, and affiliate/advertising terms. Smallest action: complete the field-level rights matrix and route the unsent permission package for human-counsel and owner review. User alert rules and sync results = evidence_needed; produce the repository/deployed data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics = evidence_needed; capture deployed consent/withdrawal behavior and GA4 configuration without enabling tracking. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data = evidence_needed; produce a read-only log, vendor, retention, access, incident, and data-request inventory.

Retain containment-only execution for existing measurement, attribution reconciliation, failure repair-or-close review, and bounded legal/security evidence work. Do not create new production requests, requeues, experiments, duplicate telemetry, spend, monetization expansion, or external outreach. Incomplete telemetry alone does not block ordinary growth, but unsupported claims, rights-dependent reuse, privacy expansion, and security-sensitive exposure remain blocked or counsel_required.
